name: gro-compiler
description: Per-turn (live) GRO material compiler, bundled with a pinned copy of the ARA research-manager skill so one install gives you the whole stack. At the end of every agent turn, research-manager records the turn into the project's ARA (seeding it if absent), then gro-compiler compiles the GRO material layer on top (temporal, refs, quantities, entities, claims_typed, genre, author-stated contributions). Pure material compilation — it structures what is present in the research and writes no third-party quality assessment (no novelty typing, comparison to prior work, or significance scoring). research-manager is vendored from ARA-Labs (MIT) at the version pinned in vendor/research-manager/UPSTREAM.yaml.
